scope: Method applicability map, not successful preparation results; no chemistry removed to obtain a passing case

cases.label: MMP8–hydroxamate
cases.approach: New closed-shell catalytic Zn cluster; separate structural Zn and Ca models
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Five-coordinate hydroxamate Zn is outside four-coordinate ZAFF. Structural His/His/His/Asp site is a center9 candidate after contextual mapping.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Explicit hydroxamate deprotonation and donor His tautomers; Ca retained and separately checked.
cases.actual_status: Native 97/139-atom catalytic MCPB inputs exist; fixed-geometry QM screening is separate from site acceptance.

cases.label: MMP1–hydroxamate
cases.approach: Same chemistry family as 1MNC; validate each complete site
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: ZAFF9 may fit structural 3His/Asp Zn; no direct ZAFF for five-coordinate catalytic Zn.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: PLH hydroxamate state; two distinct Zn sites plus Ca; no untested transfer from 1MNC.
cases.actual_status: Requires catalytic model and validation of every retained metal.

cases.label: MMP9–hydroxamate
cases.approach: Hydroxamate catalytic Zn plus structural Zn and multiple Ca sites
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: ZAFF9 structural candidate only; new five-coordinate NFH catalytic model.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: NFH protonation and exact donor graph; all five Ca sites and relevant waters.

cases.label: MMP13–non-zinc-binding inhibitor
cases.approach: Published four-coordinate Zn-water family candidate plus structural Zn
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: ZAFF6/7 catalytic water/hydroxide alternative; ZAFF9 structural candidate.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Metal-bound water versus hydroxide; local His mapping and two Ca sites; inhibitor retained.
cases.actual_status: Closest MMP candidate for a published-model path, pending actual mapping and full tests.

cases.label: ADAM17–hydroxamate
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Outside ZAFF four-coordinate scope; native MCPB/PySCF candidate.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: INN hydroxamate state and three His tautomers.
cases.actual_status: Needs new fitted site, parameter checks and full complex motion.

cases.label: Carbonic anhydrase II
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: ZAFF6: HD4=His94, HD5=His96, HE2=His119, WT1=water263, ZN6=Zn262; alternate center7 hydroxide.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Water state is a declared benchmark hypothesis; source has no pH field. Distinct histidines mapped by source backbone contacts.
cases.actual_status: Complete 4534-atom dry native model retains 2207 source heavy atoms; parameter comparison passed; motion and independent energy precision check ongoing.

cases.label: HDAC8–trichostatin A
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: No matching standard ZAFF template established. Requires explicit graph/state review before QM.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Two Asp donors, His and TSN contacts; deposited six contacts include N1 requiring chemical interpretation. Two Ca and two Na retained.
cases.actual_status: Do not force a 3His model onto this site.

cases.label: Calmodulin
cases.approach: Explicitly named Ca nonbonded model with coordination validation
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Installed water-model-matched Amber 12-6 baseline; 12-6-4 is a distinct candidate requiring exact C4 propagation.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Four Ca sites; carboxylate and water identities retained. Hydration fitting alone is not a protein-site validation.
cases.actual_status: Separate nonbonded Ca family, outside bonded Zn proof.

cases.label: Horse liver alcohol dehydrogenase
cases.approach: Distinct catalytic and structural Zn sites in the full dimer
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: ZAFF1 is a structural four-Cys candidate; catalytic two-Cys/His/two-water site outside four-coordinate ZAFF. Native NADH/NAD+ libraries available.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Deposited title reports NADH hydroxide adduct but component NAD alone does not define the cofactor state. Preserve all four Zn and both cofactors.
cases.actual_status: Resolve cofactor/catalytic state; published structural template alone cannot pass whole case.

cases.label: PPM1A phosphatase
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Installed Mn hydration parameters are only a baseline; no matched coupled-site model verified.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Mn oxidation, high-spin/coupled spin, bridging water protonation, phosphate state and both Mn sites.
cases.actual_status: Current spin-zero QM worker cannot fit this model; explicit open-shell provider/method work required.

cases.label: Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase
cases.approach: Joint Cu/Zn site with bridging histidine
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Independent neutral-His ZAFF9 plus bare Cu is not a valid joint model.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Cu redox/spin, His63 imidazolate bridge, water state; full dimer.
cases.actual_status: Requires joint redox/state-specific model, not separable site substitution.

cases.label: CDK2–ATP/Mg
cases.approach: Mg/ATP protein site using explicit nucleotide and ion model
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Published Carlson ATP phosphate family is a candidate; named TIP3P Mg baseline. Nucleotide 12-6-4 corrections documented for TIP4PEW must not silently transfer.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: ATP charge/protonation, three phosphate donors, Mg occupancy and bound water.
cases.actual_status: Prior standard preparation does not establish advanced coordination fidelity; test full complex and retained site.

cases.label: Oxy-myoglobin
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Installed old heme-His and P450 dioxy templates are not a verified oxy-myoglobin match. P450 dioxy uses proximal Cys and is not a drop-in.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Fe/O2 electronic state, proximal His and distal environment; oxygen and sulfate retained.
cases.actual_status: Need an actual published matched oxy-His heme model or new validated open-shell treatment.

cases.label: Human MnSOD H30V
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: No validated complete matched model established from installed templates.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: Mn oxidation/spin and bound solvent; declared oligomer retained.
cases.actual_status: Outside current closed-shell Zn QM worker; distinct model/provider validation required.

cases.label: Carbonic anhydrase II–dansylamide
cases.approach: Published native MCPB Zn-sulfonamide reference plus separate retained Hg
cases.published_or_installed_candidate: Native 18 Seminario terms and ESP extraction reproduced; current native RESP parity passed, historical published charges differ.
cases.state_or_transfer_decisions: MNS anion; Hg at Cys205 and its source contacts cannot be deleted to claim full case success.
cases.actual_status: Zn adapter reference only; complete panel case still requires a defensible Hg model.
